■ Stage Direction
1 second silence at start

—The love of so many people is pushing me forward.
I recall her words.

...However.
Today, Kakehashi-san was nowhere to be seen...

A little furrow in your brow, that adorable little groan.
What's on your mind, Trainer?

Ehehe♡
Though it wasn't just me who embodied it—it was "all of us," you know? ♪
You may be in a position to guide an Umamusume, but...

Watching this, I'm reminded once again that merely doing my job as a Trainer
isn't enough. I need to support her with something special that goes beyond that...

After saying goodbye to fellow members in the Loves Only You fan community,
I shut down my PC.
...Really? In that case, no worries.
"Do your best out there for all of us, too!"
"We're counting on you, Kakehashi!"

My relationship with Loves Only You is going great. If she has any worries,
she immediately consults me, and we've built a solid mutual trust.

—Phew! That was so much fun today!
Everyone seemed full of energy, totally happy and brimming with love.

Even with just a simple greeting, my community peers welcomed me warmly
and showered me with encouraging words, watching over me.

Alright, time to start training.
Let's give it our all again today!

...There's always someone keeping me in their thoughts.
Loves Only You... You really are the luckiest girl alive.

(Even before becoming my Trainer, Kakehashi-san and the fans
put so much thought into everything for my sake.)

Exchanges like this have become second nature.
—Step by step, we've built up trust ever since that day.

Trainer! There's something I'd like to consult you about,
do you have a moment before training?
You may be in a position to guide an Umamusume, but...

The love of so many people is pushing me forward.
As long as I'm not alone... I can grow stronger without limits! ♪

That doesn't mean you can't come to your trainee...
to me, for advice, you know?

Trainer! There's something I'd like to consult you about,
do you have a moment before training?
"Thanks for your hard work~! Rooting for you in training!"

A little furrow in your brow, that adorable little groan.
What's on your mind, Trainer?

Even if I ask, you probably won't just tell me honestly.
You have such a strong sense of responsibility, and you always push yourself so hard...

(...Could it be about me, by any chance?
If so, you'd be even less likely to bring it up.)

Yeah, let's go with that plan!
Ehehe. As I thought, talking to you is always the best whenever I'm in doubt.

(I knew it, is something troubling you?
Are you brooding over it all by yourself right now, too...?)

For the sake of everyone who supports us, and for Loves Only You.
As her Trainer, I need to keep pushing myself—

Allow me to make a correction. There are Umamusume who become stronger for the sake of others.
...And you've embodied that perfectly.

Yeah, let's go with that plan!
Ehehe. As I thought, talking to you is always the best whenever I'm in doubt.

Alright then, see you next time!
Love me♡ Love you♡ This was Loves Only You! ♡

The next day.
As I sit groaning in the Trainer's office without any answers in sight—

Ever since becoming Loves Only You's Trainer,
my posts in the community had decreased somewhat due to how busy I was, but...

I look back over Loves Only You's past streams.
The love from her, the love from her fans, and the time that connects them.
